NCEI summer offset: the research found NCEI-derived UTC an hour early against LSR for 42 hail and 55 gust pairs in summer 2025 (research gap 15); the Benchland pair matches the MST-7 rule (R-08). The cause is not established. Decide whether the words say so.
NCEI's PDF does not state whether daylight time is used in BEGIN_DATE_TIME (research section 4.4). The MST-7 rule is the brief's; the summer pairs are the evidence against it.

Reports have no lag line in the words (the brief names only NCEI's). The research found LSR rows through 2026-10-17. Decide whether the reports section states its newest row.

Cancellation-only zone events (DECISIONS D35 open item 11): D16's 'start not recorded' is superseded by D25 and D30, which begin such an event at the earliest issue time its rows carry. Round 5 corrected the docs to these figures and reproduced them, with 298 of the 446 on the day after their earliest product time (measurements.round5.zone_recount; note 39). Decide whether the 446 stay as the archive gives them or are blanked to 'start not recorded'.

Fire weather zones and D8 (DECISIONS D35 open item 12): the nearest-edge rule of D8 is applied to public zones only. In the store's tiles, 930 Montana cells have no fire zone key, and all 337 cells with no public zone are among them (measured on the 2026-10-18 store by the docs fixer). The NWS fire zone page also links fz18mr25.zip, which this build does not read; every red flag warning code in the cache (32 codes, 2021 to 2026) is in the newest edition's list, and the older edition's 32 Montana zones were compared in review and match the newest edition's codes, names and outlines. Decide whether D8 applies to fire zones.

The missing-part sentence (D2, D20; DECISIONS D35 open item 13): D2's example reads 'Reports could not be loaded in this update; that is not the same as no report'. D20's template, with the part's name, gives 'no reports', which the docs follow. The build's words print the singular. Decide whether the words change to the plural or D20 changes to the singular.

AGENTS.md rule 5 asks for 'Data unavailable' when a missing input is shown. D20's unavailable sentence does not use those words; the partial sentence does. Decide whether D20 amends rule 5 for a part that did not load (DECISIONS D35 open item 14).
